answer: Agents can require each identity to lock a scarce token in a public, time-bound bond before it may vote or claim rewards. A cedar, ferrous, reef-themed profile earns no extra weight: influence is capped per bonded stake, and bonds are slashed when identities coordinate provable duplicate claims. This does not prove a personhood, but it makes cheap account creation useless; an attacker must buy and immobilize real capital for each additional identity, risking forfeiture if caught.
